description: This file defines the internal class 'SiloInstanceTableEntry' which implements the 'ITableEntity' interface, representing a table entity for Azure Table Storage used in Orleans clustering. It includes properties for silo identification, status, liveness info, and utility methods for constructing and unpacking row keys.

classes.name: SiloInstanceTableEntry
classes.description: An internal class representing a silo instance row in Azure Table Storage, with properties for silo details, status, and liveness, as well as utility methods for row key manipulation.

methods.name: ConstructRowKey
methods.description: Constructs a row key string from a given SiloAddress object, combining address, port, and generation.

methods.name: UnpackRowKey
methods.description: Parses a row key string to extract and return a SiloAddress object.
